name: io.github.WYRE-AI/marketsharp-mcp
title: MarketSharp
description: MCP server for MarketSharp CRM contacts, inquiries, appointments, jobs, notes and activities.

environmentVariables.name: MARKETSHARP_COMPANY_ID
environmentVariables.description: MarketSharp Company ID (shown under your username in MarketSharp).

environmentVariables.name: MARKETSHARP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from MarketSharp: Admin → Apps & Add-ons Setup → API maintenance → Create New API Key.

environmentVariables.name: MARKETSHARP_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret issued with the API key. If there's no secret, ask MarketSharp support to turn on API access.

environmentVariables.name: MARKETSHARP_EMPLOYEE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional MarketSharp employee ID. The contact, inquiry and job search tools and marketsharp_notes_list need it, and act with that employee's permissions.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. The image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting. To run the image over stdio with the MARKETSHARP_* variables above, set MCP_TRANSPORT=stdio and AUTH_MODE=env.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source. The image sets 'gateway': credentials come only from x-marketsharp-* headers sent by the WYRE AI gateway and MARKETSHARP_* env is never read, over HTTP or stdio. Set 'env' to use the MARKETSHARP_* variables; stdio needs it. Over HTTP any other value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
